sections.p: You keep the rights you have in what you submit. By submitting you confirm you may share it, and you grant this site permission to publish it, keep its revision history and show it alongside other versions.
Contributions are reviewed before they are public. Published lyrics may be shown in several versions side by side; no version is merged into another without a visible record.
Do not submit work you do not have the right to share, do not harass others, and do not abuse the service. Accounts that do may be limited or removed.
Rights holders can send a notice. Contributors may appeal a takedown. Both processes are described on the copyright page.
Your account email and display name, the contributions and comments you write, and an audit record of consequential actions. Pending and private content is never shown publicly.
If you file a legal notice, your name and email are visible only to the moderators and administrators who handle it.
You can ask for a copy of your data or for its erasure by filing a privacy request on the copyright page. Published contributions may need to be kept or anonymised to preserve revision history.
One session cookie, needed to keep you signed in. No advertising or tracking cookies.
Original lyrics you wrote, translations and transliterations you made, and lyrics you have permission to share.
Lyrics copied without permission, spam, harassment, hate speech, and personal data about other people.
Use the report button on any contribution or comment. Moderators review reports; the author of a hidden comment may appeal.
